operational_nodes.name: WorkspaceManifestForbidGate
operational_nodes.doc: Enforces forbid lint levels in root Cargo.toml and workspace = true inheritance across all member crates.

operational_nodes.name: ClippyAttributeAstScanner
operational_nodes.doc: Zero-regex multi-line token-stream scanner in Check 34 rejecting allow(clippy:: attribute sequences.

operational_nodes.name: CrateRootAttributeSanitizer
operational_nodes.doc: Strips crate-level #![allow(clippy::...)] headers and replaces complex tuples with named structs or type aliases.

operational_nodes.name: TestTargetLintEnforcer
operational_nodes.doc: Enforces identical forbid lint discipline across unit tests (#[cfg(test)]) and integration tests (tests/*.rs).

operational_nodes.name: RangeSliceAstDetector
operational_nodes.doc: Zero-regex token-stream analyzer that detects panicking Rust bracket range indexing (`expr[a..b]`, `expr[..b]`, `expr[a..]`) outside string literals, comments, and `.get(..)` calls

operational_nodes.name: FailClosedIoAstVerifier
operational_nodes.doc: AST pattern verifier that rejects fail-open iterator flattening, `.filter_map(Result::ok)`, `.unwrap_or_default()` on filesystem reads, and `let _ = fs::` error discarding

operational_nodes.name: AntiGamingTestBodyAuditor
operational_nodes.doc: Test AST auditor that parses `#[test]` functions and rejects zero-assertion bodies, `mem::size_of` tautologies, unguarded `.exists()` skips, and non-RAII temp paths

operational_nodes.name: SsotSymbolDeduplicationGate
operational_nodes.doc: Workspace-wide AST symbol scanner enforcing single-module residency for SHA-256 constants (`0x428a2f98`) and Rust lexical state machines

operational_nodes.name: NativeSigilAndLifetimeLexer
operational_nodes.doc: Zero-rewrite scanner emitting native `Ampersand`, `Question`, `Lifetime`, and `DoubleColon` tokens with exact byte spans

operational_nodes.name: FailClosedRecursiveDescentParser
operational_nodes.doc: Strict token-stream parser for all 12 inner declaration blocks, composite type expressions, and nested state transitions

operational_nodes.name: BijectiveSysmlSerializer
operational_nodes.doc: Canonical `SysmlSerializable::to_sysml` formatter preserving 100% of `PackageDef` AST fields without double-quoting

operational_nodes.name: CompilerRoundtripVerificationGate
operational_nodes.doc: Built-in compiler verification stage asserting `parse_sysml(to_sysml(ast)) == ast` on every `compile-sysml` run

operational_nodes.name: UnifiedRustDartLexicalScanner
operational_nodes.doc: Canonical zero-regex lexical state machine in `deap_core::source_ast` handling nested `/* */`, `r#"..."#`, Dart `${...}` frames, and exact char-literal vs. lifetime disambiguation

operational_nodes.name: ScopedSchemaContextResolver
operational_nodes.doc: Strict SysML v2 requirement and constraint resolver in `compile-sysml` traversing recursive `part.parts` trees with `owner_name` isolation and zero `.first()` fallback

operational_nodes.name: SevenSectionDocstringGenerator
operational_nodes.doc: Deterministic forward synthesizer interpolating AST parameters, return types, struct fields, invariants, and `Realises:` bindings into unique 7-section docblocks

operational_nodes.name: Check36AstCompletenessVerifier
operational_nodes.doc: Baseline verification gate in `verify-baseline` auditing 100% per-item 7-section docstring coverage and Check 34 normalized body uniqueness using `deap_core::source_ast`
